Grit jang jeetati hai.
Silence wisdom ki loudest voice hai.
Kabhi kabhi jawab ki sab se safe form khamoshi.
Grit tab bhi rukna hai jab dard ho.
Himmat sahi kaam applause ke bina.
Khamoshi wisdom ki breathing hai.
Bahaduri bhare kaam aatma ko darshate hain.
Darr sirf ek mansik avastha hai.
Success aakhri nahi, failure maut nahi: aage badhne ki himmat hi maine rakhti hai.
Ek man destroy ho sakta, defeat nahi.
Himmat na chillana—bas khade rehna.
Khamoshi rooh ko theek karti hai.
Apne darr ko jeeto.
Grit matlab kabhi haar na manna.
Grit lambe samay ka junoon hai.
Grit woh hai jo tum quit karne ke baad karte.
Kuch battles ladni padti hain, jinka explain nahi hota.
Asli himmat rakho.
Hum sab ko do me se ek suffer karna hai: discipline ka pain ya regret ka pain.
Himmat main hoon.
